## 7be1519f847c

**Classification: reproduced generator-contract defect and lesson shortcut.**
No files for this audit target were modified.

The easy branch requests exactly two rings, but ordinary seed `10`, sample index
`0`, difficulty `easy` returns an 8x7 input with only **one** ring;
`self_check` returns `[]`. Seed `12` repeats the same failure. The generator stops
after placement attempts and accepts any count >=1, so its returned count can be
lower than the requested curriculum count. Seed `0` has two rings.

A concrete two-demo/one-query counterexample uses easy seeds `10`, `12`, then
`0`. The wrong rival “fill only the first detected ring center” matches both
one-ring demonstrations and disagrees on the two-ring query: match vector
`[true, true, false]`. All inputs are ordinary unoverridden draws and pass the
target validator. Canonical Racket outputs, grids, hashes, and the exact command
are in `checks/audit/7be1519f847c/counterexample.json`.

Secondary contract findings: advertised values such as `grid_h=5`, `grid_w=16`,
and `n_rings=1|6` are rejected in the easy branch despite appearing in `AXES`;
`palette_kind`, `palette_size`, and `n_distinct_colors` are accepted but do not
change the output; an unknown key is accepted. Direct probe output is retained in
`checks/audit-probes.log`.
